QUOTE: The deny list is enforced later, inside `ServerManager::execute`, not in the approval step. ... `is_denied(tool, pattern)? → "Permission denied" JSON, call stops` then `route_tool_call`

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer places the deny check in ServerManager::execute before routing, but it never concludes that deny is the only list that blocks execution. It also describes other blocking checks, including an allow-list gate that denies a call when there is no approval, and it says "Otherwise the call is denied".
